Who am I?

Your Next Marketer

Showcasing Passion, Vision, and Creativity

I'm a marketing student at the University of Wisconsin–Madison with a passion for creativity, digital media, and creating experiences that bring people together.

Through my experiences in sports marketing, social media, event marketing, and community engagement, I've developed a strong interest in connecting people with brands and experiences in meaningful ways.

I thrive in fast-paced environments where creativity, communication, and teamwork come together, and I'm always looking for opportunities to learn, create, and make an impact.

Work with me

What's in my bag?

I experience products and brands everywhere, from my feed to my coffee run. Paying attention to why people reach for certain brands is how I think about marketing.

Badger Roots

Madison has been part of my story my whole life. It’s where my love of sports, fans, and community began. Growing up here gave me a deep connection to the people and places that make Madison special, while working and going to school here has taught me the value of service, connection, and creating meaningful experiences for others.

Through my experiences in Madison, I’ve learned that marketing is about more than promoting a product or event, it’s about bringing people together. From creating content and supporting local organizations to working in sports and engaging with fans, I’ve seen firsthand how strong marketing can build community and create lasting memories.

Experience

Marketing Intern

Madison Mallards & Madison Night Mares

My experience with the Madison Mallards and Madison Night Mares gave me hands-on experience in sports marketing, game-day operations, and fan engagement. Working in a fast-paced environment taught me how to collaborate across teams, manage details under pressure, and create memorable experiences for fans. From executing promotions and themed game nights to supporting sponsorships and community events, I learned how every detail of a game day contributes to the overall brand and fan experience.

Social mediaGame-day promosSponsorship activationOn-field promotionsThemed nightsCommunity outreachOff-site events

Social Media & Events on the Field

Mascot and player appearances, giveaways, and special events created memorable game-day experiences that brought fans closer to the teams. Moments such as Hudson Westbrook performing at the ballpark and a Tucker Kraft meet-and-greet demonstrated how athlete appearances and unique experiences can turn an ordinary baseball game into a lasting memory for fans.

Social Media Marketer

UW–Madison Kinesiology Department

I create content designed to engage students, faculty, and the wider department audience by highlighting research, student experiences, events, and department achievements. This role has strengthened my ability to turn complex information into clear, engaging content while understanding what different audiences want to see. Through social media strategy, content creation, and performance analysis, I have learned how thoughtful storytelling can build community and strengthen a brand’s online presence.

Content creationSocial strategyAudience engagementCreative communication

Waitress & Bartender

State Street Brats

Working at a busy Madison bar has strengthened my communication, time management, and ability to stay calm under pressure. Interacting with customers every day has given me firsthand insight into how people experience a business and how small interactions can shape their perception of a brand. This experience has strengthened my understanding of customer service, adaptability, and the importance of creating memorable experiences.

Marketing With Purpose

Growing up in Madison made me passionate about giving back. Through my church I've helped organize events that bring neighbors together.

Fireworks Event

The annual Fourth of July fireworks event provided an opportunity to bring families and community members together for a fun and memorable evening. Helping with planning, logistics, volunteers, and promotion showed me the importance of coordination and attention to detail in creating a successful community event.

Ice Cream Social

The annual ice cream social created a welcoming space for community members to connect, spend time together, and learn more about the church. Supporting the planning, setup, and promotion helped create an engaging experience that encouraged participation and strengthened connections within the community.
